style: Franco-Belgian ligne claire comic artwork: uniform clean black outlines of even weight, flat bright colours with no gradients and no hatching, clear readable shapes, like a classic European album page.
suffix: Clean artwork only: no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no speech balloons, no captions, no sound-effect lettering, no signature, no logo, no panel border, no frame; the picture runs to the edges of the image.

items.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain pure white background, full-body figures standing side by side in a neutral pose, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced with wide white gaps between them so each can be cut out separately, no shadows on the ground, no background scenery. Left: Lola, a 9-year-old Spanish girl with freckles, light brown hair in two pigtails tied with red ribbons, a green dress with white collar, white socks and red shoes, cheeky grin. Middle: abuelo Paco, her grandfather, a retired baker in his seventies, round belly, big white moustache, rosy cheeks, round glasses, a black Basque beret, a mustard-brown buttoned cardigan over a white shirt, brown trousers. Right: Carmen, a market fruit seller in her forties, plump, dark curly hair tied back, red-and-white striped apron over a blue blouse, friendly broad smile.

Sunday morning in Madrid: wide establishing shot of a historic iron-and-glass covered market hall on a sunny little plaza, shoppers with baskets and bags, pigeons on the cobblestones, old buildings with balconies around. No shop signs, no writing anywhere. Keep the top third quiet and uncluttered (clear blue sky) so speech balloons can be lettered there later.
